pr_title: init cli: add option for installing package
pr_body:
Closes: #3582

Added options for installing package either using npm or yarn by providing `--pm` or `--manager` option
pr_comments:
I'm sorry for so late review, just found a time to review it.
Are you still interested in this change? Looks like imnotjames don't have a time currently to answer your questions. Let me review it.
Yes, I'm interested in these changes.

Any reason why are you not running `npm install` after create the project structure when using: `typeorm init --name MyProject --database mysql --express`?
comments:
I think the reason is that some users are using `yarn` instead of `npm`. But it is no so killing feature and maybe someone could contribute :-) 

E.g. angular-cli is good point to check:
https://github.com/angular/angular-cli/blob/master/packages/angular/cli/tasks/npm-install.ts

Proposal:
adding new flag `--pm` (package manager) accepting two values `npm` or `yarn`.
If flag is not provided or wrong flag is provided then default value will always be npm.
Is it good?

review_comments: Can we instead just make a flag for `yarn` and install with `npm` by default?  What does webpack do?
I thought of making npm default option if flag is not provided. We can make one flag for yarn installation only. Need your confirmation here.
default should be npm, if users use `init` command without `pm` option specified - it should work and default should be npm.
If these are the valid values, should we set `choices` to these two?
